name: Shimmer Wave Text
description: A headline where a soft light wave sweeps across the letters, lifting each one as it passes; follows the pointer on hover.

name: Gradient Wave Text
description: A large heading filled with a flowing multi-stop gradient while the letters ride a gentle wave; pointer steers the flow.

name: Staggered Text
description: Rotating hero phrases whose letters enter and exit with a staggered blur-and-rise; click or use arrow keys to advance.

name: Rolling Counter
description: An odometer-style revenue KPI where each digit column rolls to its new value with a staggered spring.

name: Dust Text
description: Thousands of glowing dust particles assemble into a word and scatter away from the pointer.

name: Liquid Chrome Text
description: Polished liquid-metal lettering with rippling surface and moving specular reflections that track the pointer.

name: Typewriter AI Text
description: An AI assistant answer that streams in token by token with a glowing gradient caret and soft fade-in.

name: Orbiting Dots
description: Glowing dots orbit a pulsing core on three tilted rings with depth-sorted perspective; pointer tilts the system.

name: Morph Loader
description: A soft gradient blob that morphs between circle, rounded square and triangle while it spins.

name: Circular Progress
description: A gradient ring progress indicator with a glowing end-cap and counting percentage; drag around the ring to scrub.

name: Skeleton Shimmer
description: A social post skeleton with a sweeping shimmer that resolves into real content, then loops; click to toggle.

name: Pulse Equalizer
description: A voice-assistant listening state with a pulsing gradient mic orb, live equalizer bars and a streaming transcript.
